
{{alias}}( t, y, p )
    Computes the hinge loss between two double-precision floating-point numbers.

    If any argument is `NaN`, the function returns `NaN`.

    If `y` is not +1 or -1, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    t: number
        Threshold value.

    y: number
        True target value.

    p: number
        Predicted value.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Hinge loss.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 1.0, 1.0, 0.782 )
    ~0.218
    > v = {{alias}}( 2.4, 1.0, 0.202 )
    2.198
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.1, 1.0, -0.999 )
    2.099
    > v = {{alias}}( 0.0, -1.0, 0.2 )
    0.2
    > v = {{alias}}( NaN, 1.0, 0.987 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
